## Why visit

A serious cider option worth separating from the usual pub-interior itinerary. CAMRA describes a large real-cider range, normally including perry and local Dee Cider, alongside cask and Belgian bottles. The plain, bright former cycle shop keeps attention on the drinks, making it particularly useful for comparing cider styles with someone who can explain the board. It can anchor a dedicated cider excursion or combine with the Red Fox meal stop, but the route needs bus or taxi planning rather than assumptions about station proximity.

## Beer

CAMRA records a Beartown-brewed house pale and changing cask; the operator advertises four handpulls and craft taps.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA documents up to eight real ciders, including Dee Cider and usually perry. Availability and qualifying products should be checked.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Plan the visit

CAMRA describes third, two-third and pint beer measures, with no halves. Ask what tasting measures are available.

**Getting there:** Near Heswall centre and bus station; railway station is farther away.
